case.title: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.. Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red. Need: 15900 pc a year. Category goal: quality first: defects and late deliveries cost more than a few cents of price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 58 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200011. Must-haves: ppm_commitment <= 1500. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain flexible and look forward to hearing from you soon so we can start building a strong partnership together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for your warm message and your offer. We value your commitment to a long-term partnership and share that goal.

Before we move forward, a few points from our records matter to us:

Your on-time delivery was 63.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

Quality on these bearing brackets is our main concern, so a clear quality commitment backed by a simple complaint mechanism is central for us. Our proposal reflects this, together with a price in line with our order history:

Our proposal: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 500.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.05.

We believe this gives both sides a solid basis for a lasting partnership and look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,
thank you for your mail, we are very happy to hear from you!
we can move a bit:
Our terms: a price of €49.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €500.00 per complaint.
To be fully transparent with you:
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything.
Thanks for the message, we know our delivery was a bit sloppy lately but we are on it.
We can agree to the 300 ppm, but 500 EUR chargeback is too high, so I changed it to 150 EUR.
I can offer 46.50 EUR with these terms, but we really need you to start paying on time.
Alternatively, with a chargeback of €150.00 per complaint: €46.50 per unit.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net.
Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.
We really want this business - let's make it happen!
Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for checking our delivery and price data and confirming it, and for agreeing to the quality commitment. That gives us a good basis.

We have noted your points on payment. Our proposal leaves payment terms unchanged and focuses on price and quality. Quality on these brackets matters most to us, so we keep the chargeback as proposed: it gives both sides a clear reason to keep complaints rare.

Our proposal: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 500.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 44.41.

We see this as a fair footing for a lasting partnership and look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,
many thanks, good to have your reply!
we can move a bit:
Our terms: a price of €48.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €500.00 per complaint.
To be fully transparent with you:
Thanks for the message, good to hear from you again.
We can accept the 500 EUR chargeback to show we are serious about quality, but we need 48.50 EUR per unit for this setup.
Since you want to keep payment terms unchanged, we can't go much lower on price, but if you can pay faster we can definitely do better.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net.
Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.
We are ready when you are!
Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

We understand that faster payment matters to you. Our proposal keeps payment terms as they are and puts the focus on a price that fits the improved quality setup we have now agreed:

We believe this is a solid, fair basis for continuing our work together. I look forward to your confirmation.

Best regards

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our offer is a price of €48.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €500.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

You say this price fits the improved quality setup, but please show us the figures behind this. Since your payments are often late, we really need faster payment to drop the price, so we have to hold at 48.50 EUR for now. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for your reply and for confirming the quality commitment and chargeback. We appreciate the steady progress.

We have noted your cost drivers and your wish for faster payment. Our proposal keeps payment terms unchanged, so the price reflects that. To meet you, we have moved our price up from our last proposal:

Our proposal: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 500.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 45.37.

On your question about figures, we see this as a balanced step that respects your cost position and the quality setup we have agreed. We would be glad to close on this basis and look forward to your confirmation.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
